verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Gravity Impact as a Ki Blast Super that fires a short-range shockwave/projectile and can negate some Ki Blasts, costing 100 Ki.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Cell (Perfect) training is the documented acquisition route; independent instructor documentation lists Gravity Impact as Cell's Lesson 1 reward.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The evidence establishes instructor training rather than a PQ reward condition, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Current reference material contains gameplay/damage details, but exact damage values are not promoted as canonical database values because version stability is not established.

records.name: Gravity Impact
records.character_source: Cell (Perfect) and customizable partner documented by current references
records.skill_description: A Ki Blast Super that releases a short-range shockwave capable of nullifying some incoming Ki Blasts and launching the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material classifies Gravity Impact as a short-range projectile/launcher. The attack can cancel some Ki Blasts and sends a struck opponent away in a long launch state that permits follow-up attacks.
